crossRefs.note: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes…
to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment…
Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of…
“Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and…
By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…

parallels.note: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…

translations.web: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
translations.bsb: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
translations.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
translations.asv: For there is no good tree that bringeth forth corrupt fruit; nor again a corrupt tree that bringeth forth good fruit.
